principles.fiction_required: Every situational Advantage or Disadvantage must have a concrete reason the table can state.

pool_effect.playtest_note: Adding d6 Advantage contributes 2.5 expected Protocol points. Removing a smallest d6 is exactly symmetric in expectation; removal is milder when the smallest Ability is d4 and stronger when all relevant Abilities have grown beyond d6. This scaling is intentional for v0.188 playtest observation.

interaction.multiple_same_side: Multiple reasons do not stack additional effective A/D unless an explicit rule says otherwise.
interaction.cancellation: Advantage and Disadvantage cancel one-for-one. After cancellation, if reasons remain on only one side, apply that side once.
interaction.stacking: Default effective cap is one Advantage or one Disadvantage per roll.
interaction.source_display: The app/GM may display all fictional reasons even though the mechanical effect caps at one.

prohibitions: Do not label Gear dice as Advantage.
Do not label VAM-added dice as Advantage unless the VAM explicitly grants Advantage.
Do not label Mastery as Advantage.
Do not convert situational judgment into a numeric +N modifier.
Do not create an unexplained extra die.

examples.reason: Target is unaware due to a successful ambush
Heavy smoke materially obscures the target
Strong tactical position and prepared ambush
examples.effect: still one d6 unless an explicit rule permits stacking
